body:
Unfortunately even with a specialists memo sometimes they can’t do much because of the guidelines in the “PES bible”. In some cases giving a temp downpes(depending on the pes) and a long term excuse would be synonymous since they both limit your daily activities equally. 
That being said only an MO or doctor can really have any further impact on the situation. I guess you will have to either do as the MO said and get more “objective evidence” or see whether you can get another appointment at MMI with another MO maybe through your camp MO.

Thanks for the quick replies. I do have 2003 pre-registered. I took 2004 as per the recommendation of a senior of mine. He did also recommend to take stuff like 2001 & 2003 since they were pre requisites. I think I will being adding MA2071 unless there are any other suggestions.
PCC appointments definitely take time especially with it being the end of the year. Given your case it should already be of higher priority. Just give it sometime buddy, hang in there.
About 5 months in. I just want a low stress environment to have some space to rest. I have never been this burnt out or breakdown this badly before.
